textElements.rationale: The single hook line. Deliberately starts at 2.35s — after both cold-open shots — so the two hook shots inside the first 2 seconds land before any title card, per the density contract. 0.25s after shot 2 begins. 4 words needs 1.33s; given 2.90s and it ends at 5.25s, before the 5.40s cut. y=0.17 sits in the 9:16 top safe band, clear of the centre face region.

Deliberate override of the white caption template: one warm accent colour, used only here and on the end card, so the hierarchy reads as a series marker rather than another subtitle. 0.30s after shot 3 begins; ends 6.90s, well inside the shot. 2 words needs 0.8s; given 1.20s.

textElements.rationale: The thesis of the piece, placed on the phase-1 hold (3.10s) so the longest calm shot carries the biggest line. 6 words needs 2.00s; given 2.60s. Starts 0.35s after shot 5 begins, ends 14.45s just before the 14.60s chapter change.

Sits on the speed-ramp hold and shakes against the slowed picture — the type comments on the tempo drop. 3 words needs 1.00s; given 1.20s. Starts 0.30s after shot 10 begins, ends 23.00s before the 23.10s cut.

Marks the phase-3 chapter change. Deliberately spans two shots (30.30-32.40s, crossing the 31.20s cut) so the label bridges the density jump instead of being chopped by it. 4 words needs 1.33s; given 2.10s. y=0.74 stays above the bottom-20% UI zone.

Shortest line in the edit on the shortest shot of phase 3 (1.10s) — bounce keeps the fast run playful. 2 words needs 0.80s; given 1.00s. Carries 0.15s deliberately across the 38.40s climax cut so the type is still exiting as the prism hit lands.

End card on the 4.10s held landing — the only shot long enough to let a title rest. Deliberate override to the same warm accent as 'ep. 01', bookending the edit. Fade (not zoom-blur or pop) because the landing is the calmest moment; 0.30s after the shot begins, ends 44.40s before the 45.00s timeline end.

effects.rationale: Hook-moment hit on the second shot of the cold open (0.90s). Medium-motion b-roll, no face-dominant frame flagged, so a short optical split is safe. 0.30s, lands exactly on the cut, lowest intensity of the edit so the accents can escalate.

Signature effect 1 of 2, on the speed-ramp hold. Trigger is the ramp itself: echo starts at 0.35s, the exact keyframe where speed bottoms out at 0.65x, and trails through the slow section so the held moment keeps moving. Non-consecutive with the other signature.

Chapter-change hit at 30.0s (phase 2 -> phase 3), on the same cut as the crossZoom transition. Same type as the hook hit but escalated 5 -> 9 and not on a consecutive shot, so the edit's accent ladder reads as authored.

Pattern-interrupt hit at 36.0s, 6.0s after the last accent — inside the 2-4s interrupt window for the surrounding cuts. This is the calm slow-push shot of phase 3, so a soft bloom rather than a punchy split keeps the accent matched to the motion level.

Signature effect 2 of 2, on the climax at 38.4s — the payoff moment, the strongest position in the final third. Heaviest accent of the edit, timed with the punch-in at 0.9 and the SFX hit on the same frame. Not consecutive with the echo signature.

transitions.rationale: Chapter change at 2.10s: hook block -> establish. A whip carries the snap-zoom/punch-in momentum of the two hook shots into the wide frame instead of letting the energy die on a hard cut.
Chapter change at 14.60s: phase 1 -> phase 2, where average shot length drops from 2.43s to 1.71s. Blur softens the jump into the tighter rhythm. Different type from the preceding whipPan.
Treatment change at 21.50s into the speed-ramp hold — the edit's one slow moment. A warm film-burn sweep signals the tempo shift without a hard edge. Third distinct type in a row.

Chapter change at 30.00s: phase 2 -> phase 3, the biggest density jump in the edit. crossZoom punches forward into the snap-zoom that opens the final third; paired with the escalated chromatic-aberration hit on the same frame.

Treatment change at 40.90s into the 4.10s held landing. After nine hard-driven cuts, the longest and softest transition of the edit lets the final shot settle and the end card land. Fifth distinct type — no two consecutive transitions repeat.

audioDecisions.rationale: No audio file was uploaded, so the source's own track is the only bed available. Running 45s of continuous narration from 66.0-111.0s under picture that cuts across the whole 416.4s tape gives the highlight reel a single unbroken voice spine (an extended L-cut construction) instead of 25 clipped audio fragments. Volume 0.70 keeps speech intelligible. Because this bed is the music track, cuts are placed on structural source positions and chapter changes rather than on the footage's own beat timestamps.
Impact on the hook cut at 0.90s, the same frame as the chromatic-aberration hit — the first accent of the edit needs to be felt as well as seen.
Whoosh into the speed ramp at 21.50s, timed to the ramp-down keyframe so the tempo drop has an audio cue.
Hit on the phase-3 chapter change at 30.00s, landing with the crossZoom transition and the escalated aberration.
Heaviest impact of the edit on the climax at 38.40s, coincident with the punch-in at 0.9 and the prism signature.
Soft low hit under the crossfade at 40.90s so the landing is marked but not punched — the last accent is deliberately the quietest.

captionTemplate.note: 9:16 safe band: all type sits between y=0.16 and y=0.75, clear of the top 10% and bottom 20% UI zones and clear of the centre face band.

motionMoments.rationale: Pattern interrupt 3.6s into the phase-3 run, on the whip-shake head at 33.60s. Medium-motion b-roll so a glitch reads as authored rather than fighting the frame; used once in the whole edit.

Fires on the climax cut at 38.40s together with the punch-in at 0.9, the prism signature and the heaviest SFX hit — the single moment where every emphasis channel aligns. Used once, non-consecutive with the glitch moment.

metadata.rationale: Single 416.4s source ('podcast #1.mp4', flagged b-roll / medium motion, conf .50) with no per-frame beat grid or motionPeak samples. Because no beat timestamps exist, cuts are placed on structural source positions (act openings and evenly spaced chapter jumps across the 416s) and the source's own continuous narration is used as the audio spine — picture cuts away while the voice carries, a standard podcast-highlight construction. Spine: two-shot cold-open hook (0-2.1s) -> wide establish + three build holds (2.1-14.6s) -> nine-shot mid-tempo build with one slow-ramp hold (14.6-30.0s) -> ten-shot dense run to a single 4.1s held landing (30.0-45.0s). One coherent grade (colorGrade 1.08/1.05/1.0) across every shot; five accent hits escalate from the hook to the payoff; five rendered transitions mark the four chapter changes plus the settle into the landing.
